This is a draft of a paper to be presented at the 2nd Annual Workshop in the [Exploring the Layers of Digital Archaeological Practice Series](https://www.uib.no/en/nia/177998/digital-archaeology-workshop-series-2024%E2%80%932027), whose theme this year is [Data and Technology Politics in Archaeology](https://www.uib.no/en/nia/179128/data-and-technology-politics-archaeology).
The workshop will be hosted at the Norwegian Institute at Athens from December 3-4, 2025.
A refined, peer-reviewed version will be published in the workshop proceedings.\

[This content is also available at [zackbatist.info/data-tech-poli-arch](https://zackbatist.info/data-tech-poli-arch/) for a better reading experience.]{.content-visible when-format="pdf"}
